scenarios.title: Solar particle event (SPE)
scenarios.summary: Elevated proton flux forecast. Evaluate sheltering timing vs exercise/sleep constraints and coupled stress on Reyes (MSK watch) and Park (circadian watch).

before.label: Before
before.notes: Nominal ops. Radiation 180–200 µGy/day. Reyes MSK watch already active. Park sleep efficiency 74%.

during.label: During
during.notes: SPE peak. Storm shelter occupied 6.5h cumulative. Exercise deferred. Sleep disrupted for Park + Reyes.

after.label: After
after.notes: Flux decaying. Recovery blocks scheduled. SB optimizer reallocates ARED + sleep protection under residual fatigue.

scenarios.title: Sleep disruption / isolation stress
scenarios.summary: Multi-day sleep fragmentation correlated with elevated cabin CO₂ nights and high timeline pressure. Focus crew: Park, secondary: Reyes.

before.label: Before
before.notes: Sleep efficiency within baseline band. Isolation index rising slowly.

during.label: During
during.notes: Park sleep efficiency 71%. Reyes HRV down. Interaction graph shows sleep↔HRV↔MSK coupling.

after.label: Projected recovery
after.notes: Protected rest windows + CO₂ scrubber priority nights. Forecast stress index → 0.36 if adherence ≥80%.
